mentions.name: Runtime scheduler for humans
mentions.description: A "runtime scheduler for humans" that unifies morning routines, travel checklists, and pomodoros in a single abstraction, with strong support for ad-hoc rearrangement and addition of tasks to the queue.
mentions.problem: No existing scheduler for humans combining routines, checklists, and pomodoros in one abstraction.
mentions.source_excerpt: 2. A “runtime scheduler for humans” that I wished existed, too (think morning routines, travel checklists, and pomodoros in the same abstraction—but also a lot of support for ad-hoc rearrangement and addition of the task queue).
